figures.title: How TGAP works
figures.description: Follow the original graph through concept changes, predictions and explanations.
figures.scope: Architecture illustration, not an experimental finding.

figures.title: Response distributions by model
figures.description: Boxes summarize the recorded spread of compatible concept responses.
figures.scope: Compare within a single model panel; Centralization and Bridge Trend are excluded.

metadata.comparability_scope: within one model panel only; no box spans two models

figures.title: One local element explanation
figures.description: Bars show how one prediction changed when particular elements were removed.
figures.scope: A local element-occlusion explanation, not a ranking of TGAP concepts.

metadata.comparability_scope: elements within this single explanation; not a concept ranking
metadata.selection_rule: top 18 by |impact|, ties broken by endpoint id; complete attribution retained in the source CSV
metadata.status: ONE local explanation; local ordering only

figures.title: Connections and time
figures.description: Cells show the measured response to removing one connection at one time step.
figures.scope: TGAP edge-time occlusion, not TSHAP. Values are not summed across time.

metadata.comparability_scope: one measured prediction difference per (edge, snapshot); nothing is summed over time
metadata.selection_rule: display-only top 22 edges by largest |impact| at any snapshot, then snapshots present, then edge id; deterministic, never sampled. The persisted CSV holds every (edge, snapshot).
metadata.status: TGAP edge-time attribution; NOT a TSHAP implementation

figures.title: Concept impacts, separated by model
figures.description: Each dot is a valid recorded test. Models and concept-unit groups keep their own panels.
figures.scope: Compare only within the permitted semantic group in one dataset/model panel; no global ranking.

metadata.axis_policy: one independent linear x-axis per (dataset, model, semantic group) panel
metadata.comparability_scope: within row 1 of a single panel only, where the model and dataset are fixed and the three concepts share relative-delta semantics; nowhere else
metadata.cross_model_aggregation: none - every point is one valid CSV row; nothing is averaged, normalised or ranked

figures.title: Connections between communities
figures.description: A matrix counts cross-community connections; lines show their changes through time.
figures.scope: Controlled four-community synthetic demonstration; not a real-data finding.

figures.title: One graph explanation
figures.description: Compare the original graph, its changed version, and the edited connections.
figures.scope: One controlled synthetic local explanation; edge edits are not individual attribution scores.

figures.title: When a concept matters
figures.description: Colors show the response to changing one time step at a time.
figures.scope: Synthetic demonstration. Present-only and trajectory models have distinct response patterns.

figures.title: Exploratory spread of recorded impacts
figures.description: Dots show the spread of recorded valid impacts across datasets.
figures.scope: Exploratory mixed-model plot with a signed-log axis. Model scales and concept units differ: do not use it for cross-model or cross-concept numerical ranking.

figures.title: Learned-model seed stability
figures.description: Compare recorded learned-model results across training seeds.
figures.scope: Recorded TGN evaluation, not a learned model fitted by the web workbench.

figures.title: Structure and measured response
figures.description: Compare node degree or edge persistence with the measured response to removal.
figures.scope: Node and edge occlusions are separate quantities. Association does not establish causation.

metadata.comparability_scope: within one panel only; node and edge occlusions are different quantities and are never pooled

figures.title: Individual concept responses
figures.description: Each dot is a recorded response; dots spread vertically to remain visible.
figures.scope: Read within one semantic row; model outputs and incompatible concepts are not pooled into a ranking.

metadata.layout_algorithm: realdata.make_publication._beeswarmOffsets - ascending value order, first non-colliding offset; deterministic and seedless
